children: Uniper expects core profit of €1.2 billion to €1.5 billion ($1.3-$1.65 billion) in 2027, compared with €1.1 billion to €1.3 billion forecast for this year, the German state-owned energy group said on Monday during a capital markets day.

Uniper, which Berlin is currently seeking to sell in a dual-track process, also plans to invest around €6 billion until the early 2030s, it said, with data centres becoming a key growth area for the group.

Uniper, in presentation slides, said it could capitalise on growing demand for AI-related data centres either by selling or leasing available locations with grid connections or by striking power deals with hyperscalers or operators.
The company said it had secured around 700 megawatts in grid capacity for these projects, which could materialise in Germany, Britain, the Netherlands or Sweden.
Adjusted net profit is expected at €550 million to €750 million in 2027, compared with €550 million to €650 million this year, Uniper said.
